title: The Room of the Ninth Floor
author: Petra Winterbourne
blurb: Paloma Halloran, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, has spent five years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
